title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 93 (Cold Fish Lake Camp)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Cold Fish Lake Camp
93 Those portions of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 6-20, being all areas within 1 km of Cold Fish Lake Camp. [en. B.C. Reg. 162/87, s. 29.]
